layers.text: Redraw him as a dazed mind-controlled soldier: no sword and no shield; a plain drab mid-grey tunic, nothing red or gold; a pale grey face with two empty white eyes and a small flat mouth; instead of his helmet a polished chrome control helmet with a short antenna and one glowing hot magenta light on its front; a dark gunmetal collar ring. Keep the size, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
